_comment: Which GAS global services require which OAuth scope, for projects that declare an explicit oauthScopes list in appsscript.json. GAS only auto-detects required scopes when the manifest has NO oauthScopes key at all — the moment a project lists any scopes explicitly, it stops auto-detecting and grants exactly what's listed, so a used-but-undeclared scope fails silently at the API call site (this is exactly the bug this tool was built to catch, after it happened once during Round 3 reconciliation: UrlFetchApp was added without adding script.external_request). This table is NOT exhaustive — it covers the global objects actually used somewhere in this repo. Extend it if a project starts using a new advanced service.

_notes.Session: Only actually needs userinfo.email if the code calls Session.getActiveUser()/getEffectiveUser() and reads .getEmail(); Session.getScriptTimeZone() needs no scope. This tool flags any Session.* usage conservatively (may over-flag getScriptTimeZone() calls as needing the scope when they don't) — check.js documents this in its own output rather than silently guessing which method was called.
_notes.GmailApp: Narrowed repeatedly, chasing a real live OAuth-consent-dialog crash: round 1 dropped the original full-mailbox https://mail.google.com/ to gmail.readonly + gmail.compose; round 2 dropped gmail.compose, replacing createBragDraft_()'s direct GmailApp.createDraft() call with a queue+MailApp pattern; round 3 removed gmail.readonly too and disabled scanHorizonLabel_() — the one remaining caller — as a decisive test of whether GmailApp itself, not just which Gmail scope, is the trigger. All three crashed identically, including no Gmail scope at all, which at the time pointed to a different cause (the assembled page's per-<script>-tag size — see leader-hub/HISTORY.md's 2026-09-15 entry) and every round was reverted: scanHorizonLabel_()/gmail.readonly and createBragDraft_()/gmail.compose both came back. Then a live redeploy of that size-based fix (build-time script splitting + let/const hoisting) STILL crashed identically on a project/script ID — reopening the question. Round 4 dropped gmail.compose again (createBragDraft_() now sends via MailApp.sendEmail()) and ALSO still crashed identically on redeploy. Round 5 (current): gmail.readonly dropped too, scanHorizonLabel_() disabled again (always returns []) — this project now requests ZERO Gmail scope. GmailApp does not appear in this table's real usage anymore as a result; the entry stays for if/when any of this is re-enabled. checkOAuthScopes() requires ALL scopes listed here to be present (AND semantics, same as every other service in this map) — not a general "any Gmail scope will do" statement: whatever GmailApp usage returns needs to be re-checked against whichever methods it actually calls, since this map has no per-method granularity.
